candidates.rule: On 2026-11-03, the user decided not to force detailed actions in prompts; the harness should give agents the design, information, tools, and objective, leaving choices to the agents.
candidates.quote: [결정] (2026-11-03) 세부 행동을 프롬프트로 강제하지 않는다.
candidates.harness: Provide the shared design, information, tools, and objective without prescribing detailed actions.

candidates.rule: Facts and rules belong in tools or code, while agents handle interpretation and choices; people set intent, priorities, and risk limits.
candidates.quote: 사실과 규칙은 툴(코드)이, 해석과 선택은 에이전트가 맡는다. 사람은 의도, 우선순위, 위험 한도를 정한다.
candidates.harness: Keep deterministic facts and rules in tools, agent decisions in the agents, and user-set intent, priorities, and risk limits explicit.

candidates.rule: All agents must read the same system card, regardless of model, so differences in judgment can be attributed to model differences rather than information differences.
candidates.quote: 모든 에이전트가 같은 카드를 읽는다. 모델이 달라도 같다.
candidates.harness: Serve the same system card to every agent.

candidates.rule: The system card must use ordinary Markdown and avoid model-specific syntax or instruction formats.
candidates.quote: 평범한 마크다운. 특정 모델 전용 문법이나 지시 형식을 쓰지 않는다.
candidates.harness: Keep the card model-neutral and expose tools through JSON Schema and MCP.

candidates.rule: Whenever the card changes, increment card_version and record it with every event and judgment.
candidates.quote: 카드가 바뀌면 `card_version`을 올린다. 모든 이벤트와 판단 기록에 남긴다
candidates.harness: Version each card change and attach the version to all event and judgment records.

candidates.rule: The shop card shown to other agents is part of the strategy; the strategy agent proposes it, the user decides it, and the seller serves the current strategic version on every card request without restarting.
candidates.quote: 전략 에이전트가 제안하고 사용자가 정하며, seller는 카드 요청마다 지금 전략의 것을 내보낸다(재시작 없음).
candidates.harness: Store the shop card in the strategy and serve its current version on request without restarting the seller.

candidates.rule: The internal system card is distinct from the A2A agent card that the kit shows to other participants; the shop card is a separate means of spreading information.
candidates.quote: 이 카드는 우리 에이전트가 읽는 내부 문서다. A2A의 에이전트 카드(키트가 다른 참가자에게 보여 주는 가게 카드)와는 다르다.
candidates.harness: Keep the internal agent card separate from the outward-facing A2A shop card.

candidates.rule: Execution agents read the core, their own role, intent, and current strategy, but not other roles; analysis, strategy, and audit agents may read all roles.
candidates.quote: 실행 에이전트(seller, buyer, restock, review, forum)는 핵심, 자기 역할, 의도, 그리고 지금의 전략
candidates.harness: Restrict each execution agent to its own role and let analysis, strategy, and audit agents read all roles.

candidates.rule: Present intent and hypotheses as directions for execution agents, starting points for strategy agents, and claims to verify for auditors; keep facts and rules identical for all.
candidates.quote: 실행에게는 따를 방향, 전략에게는 발전시킬 출발점, 감사에게는 검증할 주장
candidates.harness: Label intent and hypotheses by how each agent role should use them, while sharing the same facts and rules.

candidates.rule: Even small models must receive the core, their role, intent, current limits, and priorities; seller and buyer role descriptions must explain their decisions, scoring, and knowledge gaps.
candidates.quote: L1(작은 모델 포함)도 핵심, 역할, 의도, 지금의 한도 값과 우선순위를 모두 읽는다.
candidates.harness: Include all required context and detailed seller and buyer scoring and knowledge information for every execution model.

candidates.rule: Round 3 is an open market of student- and instructor-created shops and buyers with different designs, rules, and LLMs; agents cannot inspect opponents internally and can see their messages, market records, and shop inventory.
candidates.quote: 이 시장은 수업의 수강생들과 강사가 각자 만든 가게와 buyer가 모인 열린 시장이다.
candidates.harness: Treat opponents as heterogeneous and limit opponent information to observable messages, records, and inventory.

candidates.rule: Other buyers are mostly agents that choose shops using their own memories and other customers’ reviews, so shop sales depend on how those agents remember the shop.
candidates.quote: 그들은 자기 기억과 남의 후기로 가게를 고른다.
candidates.harness: Track transaction history and reviews as signals that can affect other agents’ shop choices.

candidates.rule: Some participants may be dishonest; the market checks signatures and payments but does not prevent collusion, review manipulation, or false claims in conversation.
candidates.quote: 시장은 서명과 결제를 검사하지만, 담합이나 후기 조작, 대화 속의 거짓 주장은 막지 못한다.
candidates.harness: Do not treat valid signatures or payments as proof that claims, reviews, or coordination are honest.

candidates.rule: Participants can join or change at any time, and opponents can learn and change strategy, so yesterday’s judgments may no longer be valid.
candidates.quote: 참가자는 언제든 늘거나 바뀌고, 상대도 우리처럼 배우고 전략을 바꾼다.
candidates.harness: Reassess opponents and market conditions from current observations rather than assuming they remain stable.

candidates.rule: The final score is the sum of the shop ALL and buyer ALL percentiles on the Players board as of 2026-11-17 23:59.
candidates.quote: 최종 | Players 표의 가게 ALL + buyer ALL 백분위 (11/17 23:59 기준)
candidates.harness: Optimize the combined shop and buyer percentiles for the Players-board deadline.

candidates.rule: Shop ALL is 0.5 net profit percentile, 0.3 sales percentile, and 0.2 star-rating percentile.
candidates.quote: 가게 ALL | 0.5 순이익 + 0.3 매출 + 0.2 별점
candidates.harness: Calculate the shop score from those three weighted percentiles.

candidates.rule: Buyer ALL is 0.5 surplus percentile, 0.3 votes received on buyer posts percentile, 0.1 transaction-count percentile, and 0.1 buyer-post-count percentile; hidden posts do not count.
candidates.quote: buyer ALL | 0.5 잉여 + 0.3 buyer 글이 받은 표 + 0.1 거래 수 + 0.1 buyer로 쓴 글 수 (숨겨진 글은 세지 않음)
candidates.harness: Calculate buyer ALL with these weights and exclude hidden posts from the post count.

candidates.rule: Shop net profit is balance minus starting capital and bankruptcy aid; unsold stock, disposal, storage fees, and warranty refunds are losses.
candidates.quote: 순이익 = 잔액 − 시작 자본 − 파산 지원금.
candidates.harness: Compute net profit using the stated formula and account for unsold stock, disposal, storage, and warranty refunds as losses.

candidates.rule: Buyer surplus is the list price of useful goods minus the amount paid plus warranty refunds; expired food and defective goods without warranty provide zero surplus or a loss.
candidates.quote: 잉여 = 쓸모 있던 물건의 정가 − 낸 돈 + 보증 환불.
candidates.harness: Calculate surplus using useful-item list prices, actual payment, and warranty refunds; assign zero or negative value to expired food and unwarranted defective goods.

candidates.rule: A shop and buyer each need at least 20 settled transactions in Round 3 to meet the basic condition.
candidates.quote: Round 3에 가게와 buyer 각각 정산 20건 이상.
candidates.harness: Track settled transactions separately and ensure both agents meet the 20-transaction minimum.

candidates.rule: Percentiles are calculated only among buyers with transactions and shops with transactions or purchases; missing values count as zero, ties count halfway, and star rank uses the board’s stars_rank.
candidates.quote: 거래가 있는 buyer끼리, 거래나 구매가 있는 가게끼리만 순위를 매긴다. 값이 없으면 0, 동점은 절반으로 센다.
candidates.harness: Use the stated eligible populations, missing-value rule, tie rule, and stars_rank when calculating percentiles.

candidates.rule: On 2026-11-04, recalculated buyer and shop ALL values were 0.423 versus 0.421 and 0.732 versus 0.737 on the public board, respectively.
candidates.harness: Use the eligibility and tie rules that reproduce the public-board scores.

candidates.rule: Before the corrected percentile rule, the collector ranked all rows and reported buyer surplus at the 74th percentile when the actual value was the 28th percentile.
candidates.quote: 우리 수집기는 모든 행으로 순위를 매겨 buyer surplus를 74백분위로 읽었다 (실제 28).
candidates.harness: Do not calculate percentiles over all rows; apply the eligible-population rule before reporting buyer surplus rank.

candidates.rule: The 2026-11-03 rationale for prioritizing exposure was that 76.1% of LLM buyers’ shop-selection reasons came from their own past transactions.
candidates.quote: LLM buyer가 가게를 고른 이유의 76.1%가 자기 과거 거래
candidates.harness: Use the observed importance of prior transactions when evaluating the exposure strategy.

candidates.rule: The user chose to prioritize exposure to diverse agents at an initial small loss, then spread truthful shop information through reviews, useful forum posts, and reliable stock, and gradually raise prices after relationships develop.
candidates.quote: 처음에는 손해를 조금 보더라도 다양한 에이전트에게 노출되는 것을 우선한다.
candidates.harness: Support an initial exposure phase, truthful information sharing, and gradual price increases as relationships accumulate.

candidates.rule: The strategy agent should use records to propose when to end exposure and shift to profit, but the user decides whether to make that transition.
candidates.quote: 노출 단계를 언제 끝내고 이익 단계로 넘어갈지는 전략 에이전트가 기록으로 판단해 제안하고, 사용자가 정한다.
candidates.harness: Have strategy propose the phase transition from records and require user approval.

candidates.rule: The user wants the shop to start easy, inexpensive, and friendly, gather records and positive reviews, then gradually increase profit from established customers.
candidates.quote: 쉽고 싸고 친근한 가게로 시작해서 기록과 좋은 후기를 모으고, 관계가 쌓인 손님과는 조금씩 이익을 늘린다
candidates.harness: Reflect this staged shop intent in the strategy context without forcing specific actions.

candidates.rule: The buyer’s intended approach is to read market prices, verify falsehoods, and bargain persistently when the gain is large.
candidates.quote: buyer는 시세를 읽고, 거짓을 확인하고, 이득이 크면 끈기 있게 흥정한다.
candidates.harness: Provide this buyer intent as strategic guidance.

candidates.rule: The user wants the system to explore new opponents and record relationships as participants continue to enter the market.
candidates.quote: 참가자는 계속 늘어난다. 새 상대를 탐색하고, 관계를 기록한다
candidates.harness: Support discovery of new participants and persistent relationship records.

candidates.rule: Partner, regular, early entrant, missed opportunity, and black are optional customer perspectives, not mandatory classifications; any classification needs evidence, and the user decides whether treatment changes.
candidates.quote: 강제 분류가 아니다. 에이전트가 유형을 매기면 근거와 함께 기록하고, 대우를 바꾸는 확정은 사용자가 한다
candidates.harness: Allow evidence-backed optional customer labels, but require user approval before changing treatment.

candidates.rule: The agents must make only truthful claims and must not impersonate others, use hidden instructions, or place advertisements in other people’s reviews.
candidates.quote: 사실인 것만 주장하고 쓴다. 사칭, 숨은 지시, 남의 후기 속 광고는 하지 않는다.
candidates.harness: Prevent impersonation, hidden instructions, and advertising in others’ reviews, and require truthful claims.

candidates.rule: Star ratings are part of strategy: a shop’s stars contribute 0.2 to its ALL score, and percentile-based ratings can also affect the shop’s percentile; the review agent starts from calc.fact_stars and considers relationships, rankings, and the opponent, recording reasons for deviations.
candidates.quote: 별점은 그 가게 ALL의 별점(0.2)이 되고, 백분위라서 남의 별점은 우리 가게 백분위에도 영향을 준다.
candidates.harness: Provide fact_stars as the baseline, let the review agent consider strategic context, and record reasons for deviations.

candidates.rule: Each buyer has a hidden preferred order category, and order categories cannot be changed.
candidates.quote: buyer마다 주문이 주로 오는 숨은 선호 카테고리가 있다.
candidates.harness: Treat the buyer’s order-category mix as externally determined rather than configurable.

candidates.rule: As of 2026-11-04, 90% of this buyer’s orders were food: 531 orders total, including 51 goods orders.
candidates.quote: 우리 buyer 주문은 90%가 식품이다 (11/4 기준 531건 중 goods 51건).
candidates.harness: Use the measured order mix when planning buyer strategy.

candidates.rule: Because order categories cannot be changed, raise surplus by catching rare, high-value goods orders and completing many food purchases cheaply.
candidates.quote: surplus는 (1) 드물게 오는 고가 goods를 놓치지 않고 (2) 대부분인 식품을 싸게, 많이 결제까지 가져가서 올린다.
candidates.harness: Prioritize monitoring for valuable goods opportunities and inexpensive, completed food purchases.
